value.en: A monthly plan from the public catalog with member pricing on treatments. Members sign in to see and manage their plan.

value.en: Are the shop products the ones you use?

en.NAME: ITEM 3 ANSWER
en.DESCRIPTION: CMS-authored value for Calm Harbor Spa.

value.en: Yes — the retail shelf is the same public catalog our specialists pull from during treatments.

en.NAME: ITEM 4 QUESTION
en.DESCRIPTION: CMS-authored value for Calm Harbor Spa.

value.en: What if I'm not happy with the result?

en.NAME: ITEM 4 ANSWER
en.DESCRIPTION: CMS-authored value for Calm Harbor Spa.

value.en: Tell us within 48 hours — a redo is covered by the guarantee.
